correctness.rationale: The proof identifies \(E:v^2=u^3-432\) and all \(E[3]\) using the exact division polynomial. Weil pairing and the printed type-nine point recover \(\beta=\zeta_9\) and \(\alpha=\sqrt[3]{3}\), proving \(\mathbb Q(E[9])=K\). Complex multiplication by \(\mathbb Z[\omega]\) gives a free rank-one \(R/9R\)-module and \(\operatorname{Gal}(K/L)\) is exactly \(1+3R/9R\) of order 9. Multiplication by \(3a\) has kernel sizes 81, 27 and 9 for zero, nonzero nilpotent and unit elements; determinant and Weil pairing distinguish residue classes modulo 9. Inert primes satisfy \(\#E(\mathbb F_p)=p+1\) and have three rational 3-torsion points. Chebotarev gives the four natural densities. The standalone script verifies the published representative and finite examples; the infinite claim rests on the proof.

originality.rationale: The complete four-valued rational-point spectrum, explicit cubic-residuosity condition and Chebotarev densities address finite-characteristic rationality of all type-nine points. In the complete inspected sources, Gattazzo proves the geometric existence/count and Merta--Zięba constructs coordinates; neither presents the full Frobenius-class classification. Prior private geometric orbits concern projective automorphisms, not Frobenius. Focused search gave no stronger or equivalent published statement. This is a self-review with residual bibliographic uncertainty.

value.rationale: The 72 type-nine points comprise the complete natural order-nine osculation locus of a distinguished elliptic plane cubic; rationality over prime fields is a geometric/arithmetic invariant not determined by their known 72-count, coordinate field or complex symmetry orbit sizes. The theorem gives an exhaustive four-class arithmetic phase diagram, exact splitting criterion for full rationality, and exact natural densities, illustrating ramified CM endomorphism filtration rather than a small arbitrary cutoff.
